messages:
maria: FYI — seeing repeated 401s when mobile SDK reconnects a streaming session across projects. Non-streaming RPCs are fine.

maria: Flow is: mobile exchanges SA impersonation JWT via STS -> gets access token -> opens stream. After ~15m stream reconnects and fails with 401.

maria: Example decoded token payload (redacted): `{'iss':'https://sts.example','sub':'impersonator@proj-A','aud':'https://redwood-cloud/','exp':...}` — looks like aud doesn't include target project.

lee: hmm. streaming reauth on the server expects the audience to match the original stream session resource (project-scoped). If the STS exchange returns global/redwood aud, the server rejects on reconnect. Can you paste the exact STS request body (redact secrets)?

maria: sure: `POST /v1/token` body: `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange&subject_token_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt&subject_token=<JWT>&requested_token_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token&scope=openid email`

maria: We were relying on default audience behavior. Mobile libs (Android/iOS) call our helper which didn't set audience, so STS returned platform-level aud.

ankur: policy angle: for cross-project impersonation you need the impersonator to have roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on the target SA and also ensure the token exchange sets `aud` to the resource the streamer expects. Server-side reauth validates aud==session_audience.

lee: in Node SDK we solved this by passing an explicit audience when generating the subject token exchange. Example: ```js
const resp = await stsClient.exchangeToken({
  subjectToken: jwt,
  audience: `projects/${targetProject}/serviceAccounts/${targetSA}`,
});
```

lee: then use resp.accessToken for the stream open. For mobile we should add same param in the helper. I'll open a quick PR to the mobile-auth helper.

maria: awesome — question: will that break existing users who rely on global aud? We have some Hosted users that use org-wide tokens.

ankur: shouldn't break if you make audience optional and default to previous behavior. For project-scoped streams, set audience to session resource; otherwise leave it omitted. Add a feature flag + telemetry to roll it out.

policy-bot: Reminder: cross-project impersonation requires the impersonator principal to be in the target project's IAM policy with `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator`. See https://docs.redwood.ai/iam#impersonation (internal).

lee: I'll add unit tests for stream reconnect + audience matching and add telemetry event `auth.stream.reauth.aud_set` so we can monitor failures. Will @maria for code review when ready. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — ping me the PR link. I'll run the mobile repro after the helper change.
